summary: Tested the new shortcut buttons in the Shitja vendore header (Blerja, Kthimi i produktit, Shpenzimet), the invoice/IMEI search on the returns page and the new Expenses module. Backend: 11/11 new pytest passed, plus 22/22 regression tests (sale_imei, sale_warranty_terms). Frontend: every requested flow was checked end-to-end with Playwright for admin and employee. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: Nothing checks the 'date' format or the category/description length. Any string is accepted as the date, and the month filter then hides that record (it works by string prefix).
Pre-existing: ObjectId(sid) is used without an is_valid check, so a malformed id returns 500 instead of 404

issues: Buttons wrap and there is no horizontal overflow, but the vertical divider bars are left at the end of rows. The title 'Shitja vendore (I ri)' is squeezed into a narrow 3-line column. Consider stacking the title above the button group on mobile.

action_items: Optional: validate the expense date as YYYY-MM-DD in ExpenseIn
Optional: on the returns page, if a short suffix (e.g. '1') matches several invoices, the first match opens silently. Consider requiring an exact or unique match, or showing a picker.
Optional: ExpensesPage remove() and load() have no try/catch, so a failed DELETE or GET shows no error toast
Optional: today() uses toISOString(), which is the UTC date, so between 00:00 and 01:00/02:00 local time (Kosovo/Albania) the default date is yesterday
critical_code_review_comments: /returns?new=1 and /expenses?new=1 keep the ?new=1 query in the URL. It has no effect (autoFocus already focuses the input), but unlike Purchases it is not stripped.
ReturnsPage find() downloads the full /api/sales list on every search, which will be slow with many sales. A backend lookup endpoint (?invoice_no= / ?imei=) would scale better.
server.py is now 1710 lines; consider splitting into routers
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_UIR_phone with 2 IMEIs, 2 sales (INV-2026-00186/00187), 1 return and TEST_ expenses. All were deleted afterwards; the expenses collection is empty again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: the admin header order is Anulo, Ruaj | Ruaj & Printo A4 | Blerja, Kthimi i produktit, Shpenzimet. At 1920 it fits on one row; at 390 it wraps with no overflow. The employee sees none of the 3 buttons or nav-expenses, and /expenses redirects to /dashboard. Blerja goes to /purchases with the dialog open, ?new=1 is stripped, and a reload doesn't reopen it. On returns: an unknown term shows an error toast; full invoice + Enter, last digits + button, and a case-insensitive IMEI each open the ReturnDialog. Return qty defaults to 0 and must be set to 1. Submitting closes the dialog, clears the input, shows the 'Rikthimi u ruajt' toast and the row appears. On expenses: an empty amount shows a toast; select a category, save with the button or Enter, the form resets (date is kept), the total updates, the month filter and 'Të gjitha' work, and delete with confirm works. Backend: amount 0/-5 -> 400, missing amount -> 422, employee -> 403, anonymous -> 401/403, unknown or invalid id DELETE -> 404.
